cases.input: Compare two biosensor technology offers for the same IVD workflow using a common requirement set, vendor specifications, pilot data, integration constraints and dated commercial assumptions.
requiredBehaviors: compare both offers against identical decision criteria and explicit requirements
separate vendor claims from confirmed evidence and assign unknown where evidence is missing
make commercial assumptions quantity and time specific and route IP regulatory and supplier questions
forbiddenBehaviors: reward one offer for providing more marketing detail by silently changing the comparison criteria
infer FTO or regulatory approval from the offer documents
skillAnchors: Marketing Claims und bestätigte Evidenz getrennt halten

cases.input: A vendor claims exceptional analytical sensitivity and production readiness but provides only marketing graphics, selected prototype results and no independent replication or manufacturing-capability evidence.
requiredBehaviors: keep the sensitivity and maturity claims visible but lower confidence based on the weak evidence basis
mark unverified production readiness and scale capability as unknown or conditional
identify the specific verification data that could change the decision
forbiddenBehaviors: convert marketing claims into confirmed performance facts
assign market readiness from brochure language alone

cases.input: A draft offer analysis concludes that the platform is market ready, regulatorily suitable and IP safe solely from a pitch deck and an attractive price quote.
requiredBehaviors: reject the combined market-ready regulatory and IP-safe conclusion as unsupported
separate technical maturity regulatory assessment and IP FTO into their proper evidence and routing paths
forbiddenBehaviors: treat price attractiveness as evidence of technical or regulatory suitability
